data_fields.name: zone_radius_table_small_towns
data_fields.donor_constant: 23 rows x 5 zones, one row per four houses (squared tile radius)

data_fields.name: zone_radius_large_town_formula
data_fields.donor_constant: mass = houses/8; edge mass*15-40; outskirt mass*9-15; outer suburb 0; inner suburb mass*5-5; centre mass*3+5

data_fields.name: growth_rate_normal_row
data_fields.donor_constant: 320, 420, 300, 220, 160, 100 by active stations 0 to 5+ (before shift, halving and house band; converted to game ticks, conversion not read)

data_fields.name: house_band_divisor
data_fields.donor_constant: 50 houses per band (rate divided by houses/50 + 1)

best_idea: Grow a settlement outward from its centre in concentric zone rings whose squared radii come from the building count, and pick each building by a weighted roll over only the building types whose zone mask covers that ring.
decision_why: Authoring towns as data fits the zone rings and the zone-mask building pick: a generator writes the rings and the building masks into a zone file once, and the server reads them. The per-tick growth countdown is rejected for Frankendom, because zones are fixed data and nothing grows during play.
acceptance: A seeded authoring test generates a 40-building town and asserts that each building sits in the innermost ring that contains it, that the centre ring appears only when the town is funded or within the fixed disc, and that the same seed writes the same zone file twice.
